schedules.name: Weekend results and performance review
schedules.when: Monday 08:30 Europe/London (GitHub Actions cron, UTC entries for GMT and BST; can queue up to an hour). Email delivery task Monday 10:09 Europe/London.
schedules.window: predictions whose fixtures were played since the previous review

schedules.name: Midweek fixture analysis
schedules.when: Monday 12:30 Europe/London (GitHub Actions). Email delivery task Monday 14:09 Europe/London.
schedules.window: Monday to Friday of the current week, fixtures not yet kicked off (Friday included from 3 Nov 2026, Rob)
schedules.outputs: reports/midweek/YYYY-MM-DD/ (english, european, combined PDFs + CSV + JSON), reports/chatgpt_review/chatgpt_review_YYYY-MM-DD_midweek.md

schedules.name: Weekend fixture analysis
schedules.when: Friday 07:00 Europe/London (GitHub Actions; UTC cron entries for GMT and BST; can queue up to an hour). Email delivery task Friday 08:39 Europe/London. Rob decides Friday morning; there is no Saturday run.
schedules.window: Saturday and Sunday of this weekend (from 3 Nov 2026, Rob; Friday fixtures are in the Monday midweek run)

mechanics: Each run is a GitHub Actions job (.github/workflows/football.yml): fetch football.db from branch data, py download.py --results (API-Football, the only API step), python run_v4.py <mode>, btts_audit.py and write_manifest.py, commit reports/data/logs/runs to main, push the slim database to branch data. reports/manifests/latest_<mode>.json says whether the run completed. A separate Claude scheduled task then reads the repository and emails Rob. No Friday or Saturday runs; manual runs via workflow_dispatch.
outputs_note: Each run also writes reports/manifests/<run_id>.json (completion manifest) and, for midweek/weekend/range, reports/btts_audit/<date>/ and reports/chatgpt_review/btts_audit_review_<date>_<mode>.md (independent BTTS assessment, production verdict unchanged). Since 2 Nov 2026 each midweek/weekend/range run also writes reports/research_groups/<run_id>.csv (frozen research watchlists, never selections) and each review writes reports/performance/research_groups_<date>.md.
leagues: V4.1: the 14 leagues in config/competitions.json, in Rob's order, plus in every run when games are due (Rob, 3 Nov 2026): the Champions League, Europa League and Conference League, and the domestic cups of the 14 leagues' countries (FA Cup, EFL Cup, Scottish Cup, Scottish League Cup, DFB Pokal, KNVB Beker, Coupe de France, Turkish Cup, Copa del Rey, Taca de Portugal). Cups are measured separately, outside the 14-league benchmark.
